N 为 FFT 点数；点越多分辨率越高，但时间窗越长。: N is the FFT size; more points give finer resolution but a longer time window.
与已知符号波形做相关: Correlates with the known symbol waveform
位数即动态范围：8 位 ADC 理论动态范围约 50 dB、12 位约 74 d: Bits mean dynamic range: an 8-bit ADC has about 50 dB theoretical dynamic range, 12-bit about 74 dB, 16-bit about 98 dB — whether a weak signal can be seen depends on it.
加性高斯白噪声下输出信噪比最大，是数字解调的最优前端。: Maximises output SNR in additive white Gaussian noise; the optimal front end for digital demodulation.
加窗是频谱分析的默认动作：不加窗（矩形窗）旁瓣高，会掩盖邻近的小信号。: Windowing is the default action in spectrum analysis: without a window (rectangular) sidelobes are high and mask nearby small signals.
卷积描述系统对输入的响应；相关用于同步、测距与信噪比估计。: Convolution describes a system's response to an input; correlation is used for synchronisation, ranging and SNR estimation.
可做严格线性相位（波形不畸变）、天然稳定；阶数高、运算量大。: Can give strictly linear phase (no waveform distortion) and is inherently stable; high order and heavy computation.
可分辨的最大与最小信号之比，与位数直接相关。: The ratio between the largest and smallest distinguishable signals, directly related to the bit count.
同指标下阶数远低于 FIR、效率高；相位非线性，需注意稳定性。: Far lower order than FIR for the same specification and more efficient; phase is non-linear and stability needs watching.
否则混叠；工程上常取 2.5–5 倍并配抗混叠滤波器。: Otherwise aliasing occurs; in practice a factor of 2.5–5 is used together with an anti-alias filter.
含反馈，输出也依赖历史输出: Includes feedback; the output also depends on past outputs
对有限长样本加权以抑制频谱泄漏；窗越平滑旁瓣越低，但主瓣越宽。: Weighting a finite block of samples to suppress spectral leakage; the smoother the window, the lower the sidelobes but the wider the main lobe.
幅度读数最准，适合精确测幅。: The most accurate amplitude readings; suitable for precise amplitude measurement.
微弱射频信号先放大，尽量少引入噪声。: The weak RF signal is amplified first, adding as little noise as possible.
快速傅里叶变换，把时域样本转到频域，是频谱 / 瀑布图的核心。: The fast Fourier transform converts time-domain samples into the frequency domain; it is the core of spectrum and waterfall displays.
把目标频段搬到中频或基带（模拟或数字）。: Move the target band to an IF or to baseband (analogue or digital).
把连续幅度离散为有限电平，位数 N 决定量化噪声与动态范围。: Discretising a continuous amplitude into a finite set of levels; the bit count N determines quantization noise and dynamic range.
抑制混叠与镜像，是 ADC/DAC 与 DDC/DUC 的必备环节。: Suppresses aliasing and images; an essential stage for ADC/DAC and DDC/DUC.
抽取前不滤波 = 制造混叠：DDC 里降低采样率之前必须先低通。: Decimating without filtering means creating aliasing: in a DDC you must low-pass before lowering the sample rate.
抽取降低采样率（须先抗混叠滤波），内插提高采样率（须后置平滑滤波）。: Decimation lowers the sample rate (anti-alias filtering first); interpolation raises it (a smoothing filter afterwards).
按固定时间间隔把连续信号变成离散序列，间隔的倒数即采样率 fs。: Turning a continuous signal into a discrete sequence at fixed time intervals; the reciprocal of the interval is the sample rate fs.
数字下变频 / 上变频：混频到基带并抽取（DDC），或内插并混频到射频（DUC）: Digital down / up conversion: mix to baseband and decimate (DDC), or interpolate and mix to RF (DUC) — the core of SDR.
数字混频到基带 + 抽取，降低数据率。: Digital mixing to baseband plus decimation, lowering the data rate.
数字滤波比模拟滤波更灵活：可做到近乎理想的矩形系数与严格线性相位，这正是 SDR: Digital filtering is more flexible than analogue: it can achieve a near-ideal shape factor and strictly linear phase — precisely the advantage of SDR.
无失真采样要求 fs > 2 · fmax（fmax 为信号最高频率），否则发生: Distortion-free sampling requires fs > 2 · fmax (fmax is the highest signal frequency); otherwise aliasing occurs.
满足奈奎斯特定理，位数决定动态范围。: Must satisfy the Nyquist theorem; the bit count determines the dynamic range.
满量程正弦的理论量化 SNR，N 为 ADC 位数。: Theoretical quantization SNR for a full-scale sine wave, where N is the ADC bit count.
用 FIR/IIR 选频，再做 AM / FM / SSB / 数字解调。: Select the band with FIR/IIR filters, then demodulate AM / FM / SSB / digital.
看不见的混叠：采样率不足时高频信号会「伪装」成低频，频谱与瀑布图上都是假象，采样: Invisible aliasing: when the sample rate is insufficient, high-frequency signals "disguise" themselves as low frequencies — both the spectrum and the waterfall show artefacts, so anti-alias filtering before sampling is mandatory.
约 -13 dB，旁瓣最高，适合瞬态或整周期信号。: About -13 dB, with the highest sidelobes; suitable for transients or whole-cycle signals.
约 -31 dB，通用频谱分析首选。: About -31 dB; the first choice for general spectrum analysis.
约 -58 dB，适合大动态范围测量。: About -58 dB; suitable for large-dynamic-range measurements.
自动增益控制，用可变增益把信号幅度维持在 ADC 的有效动态范围内。: Automatic gain control keeps the signal amplitude within the ADC's usable dynamic range using a variable gain.
输出只依赖有限个历史输入: Output depends only on a finite number of past inputs
过采样配合数字滤波带来的等效信噪比提升。: The equivalent SNR improvement obtained by oversampling combined with digital filtering.
采样前低通 / DAC 后低通: Low-pass before sampling / after the DAC
音频经 DAC 播放，或数据交上层协议处理。: Audio is played through the DAC, or data is handed to higher-layer protocols.
高于 fs/2 的频率被折回低频，形成无法与真实信号区分的假信号；采样前必须加抗: Frequencies above fs/2 fold back into lower frequencies, creating false signals that cannot be distinguished from real ones; an anti-alias low-pass is mandatory before sampling.
